scope: Shared M2 plane-cutter binding and segment publication/history state with five manufactured split controls and component refresh. No new installed-native numerical/dialog comparisons; M2 remains open/draft/unmerged.
rootCauses: Current fitted-plane producer persists planeFrame, while legacy GUI split read transient fit and MCP bound only target display geometry. Project loading drops transient fit, so both persisted-input paths missed the authoritative reference plane. Ordinary mesh cutters must remain finite.

GUI segment publication hid its source without owning that visibility in history, so Undo removed parts but left source hidden. MCP kept source visible/selected and copied source appearance, differing from GUI.
All-empty segment results resolved through MCP rather than matching GUI atomic rejection.
The initial plain shared publisher omitted prior MCP source-file provenance; a precommit RED caught it, and the existing mesh-copy constructor now preserves it.

sharedChanges.cutter: src/scan-split-cutter.ts validates triangle cutters and resolves reference-plane planeFrame, then legacy live fit, while ordinary meshes remain finite; explicit operation plane remains authoritative.
sharedChanges.publisher: src/scan-segment-publication.ts validates and adopts independent output buffers, preserves original part/classification indices, normal opaque part appearance and canonical source-name/segment-index names. It retains source/cutter geometry, hides source and returns modelVisibilityFor for owned Undo/Redo/Seek. Both adapters select first created owner after commit. Empty outputs fail atomically. Existing scanMeshCopy constructor retains source filename provenance with adopted immutable output, without cloning original source buffers.
sharedChanges.contracts: Existing mesh_process/scanEdit and generic segment schemas suffice. Discovery, agent guide and architecture describe updated defaults/state. Locks, cancellation, revision/retry, native geometry algorithms and 4GiB/25% guards retained.
sharedChanges.defaultsAudit: processing-client already applies SCAN_TOPOLOGY_TOLERANCE=0.001 to omitted scanEdit tolerance. No duplicate tolerance/default change was needed or made.
